title: 国产外胎能平替马牌GP5000吗？（完结）
notes: Creator test (edited 2024-12-29): two weeks of 10 km power-meter rides at 85 psi comparing the Chaoyang tire marketed as Cobra (identified as the H-496 in the creator's next post) with a GP5000; conclusion: a slower substitute rather than an equal. Not a controlled lab test; wind was not controlled. A commenter reported an H-496 Pro sidewall blowout at 400 km.
